controlled: manual-verification execution context and sender identity
findings: Existing read-only ActivityService merges bridge and Data API by their shared operation identity, includes subject links and browser/send rows; reuse in unified UI.
Its pagination, legacy absent-browser fallback, optional project filtering and deduplication are not a complete integrity/admission proof.
Partial SMTP acceptance persists server-accepted and draft sent with complete false; unified UI must consume receipt.
readDraftSendHistory performs stronger project/revision/content/message identity checks than generic activity.detail.
Manual sent/not-sent observations append mail_draft_mutations; original SMTP unknown is immutable, and not-sent creates a new draft without sending authority.
limits: No real SMTP, native SDK, real UI sender or native user-origin verification
No actual ApplicationExecutionContexts/ToolService dispatch in this experiment; those remain separate integration work
Conflict and missing-table cases are synthetic integrity/compatibility probes, not a claim normal product paths corrupt records
No product completion, new admission service, large-store performance or migration closure
